learningObjectives: Read and work with JSON data
Understand how browser storage stores key-value data
Distinguish localStorage persistence from sessionStorage lifetime

activities.title: JSON Explorer
activities.instruction: Edit a JSON object and inspect how its properties are represented as structured data.

content.concept: Read and work with JSON data
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: A JSON object contains key-value pairs inside braces.
A named key followed by a colon and its value.
A text value enclosed in double quotes.
A numerical value without quotation marks.
An ordered collection of values enclosed in square brackets.

activities.title: Session vs Local
activities.instruction: Compare what happens to stored data when the page is refreshed or the browser tab is closed.

content.concept: Distinguish localStorage persistence from sessionStorage lifetime
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: localStorage → persists across browser sessions until removed
sessionStorage → persists for the current page session
config.answer: localStorage → persists across browser sessions until removed
